_about: Ground footprints for placed models, by model file name (no extension). Each entry is a list of circles [x, z, radius] in metres, in the model's own frame before its placement scale and turn. Trees block at the trunk only, so you can walk under the canopy; rocks block their whole base. A model listed here ignores the placement's own collider number. Measured from the meshes (Dan's nature pack), 2026-11-02.
